title: Untitled (Triangle and Hands)
description: Mixed-media collage combines a three-dimensional orange-red triangular frame element suspended above two loosely rendered hands, drawn in black ink on white ground with pink and red paint washes. Beaded or sequined strands hang from the triangle's lower vertices, flanking the gestural figural forms below.
composition: suspended triangle centered above flanking hands
keywords: orange triangular frame on white ground
